judged_text: The only test in this new spec asserts `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController < Admin::AdminController`, which passes regardless of what the controller's actions do, so create/update/destroy ship with zero behavioral verification. A regression in any controller behavior passes CI: update and destroy crash with NoMethodError (500) when params[:id] matches no EmbeddableHost (nil is passed to save_host/destroy), and the blank-category_id fallback to uncategorized_category_id is never exercised — an admin acting on a stale/deleted row gets an unhandled 500 with no failing test.

adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` where `update` and `destroy` fetch a host via `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then immediately call `save_host(host)` / `host.destroy` without handling the `nil` case. If no record matches `params[:id]`, `save_host` will raise `NoMethodError` on `host.host = ...`, and `destroy` will raise on `host.destroy`, producing an unhandled 500. The new controller spec indeed only asserts subclassing and does not cover these behaviors.
